thread:
sarah-support: Heads up — Finovo escalated; their webhook action calls are either not happening or receiving reordered params after yesterday's canary. Pasting customer message and repro.

 tom-customer: hi team — after your deploy yesterday our invoice flow started failing. The model used to call our `post_payment` action with `{amount, currency, customer_id}`. Now the call either doesn't happen or we get `{currency, customer_id, amount}` which breaks our signature verification. Happening for ~15% of requests. example request id: req_7a9c3f. Repro cURL below.

 ```bash
 curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
   -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxx" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{
     "model": "redwood-serval-2026",
     "input": "Complete payment: amount=49.99, currency=USD, customer_id=finovo-123",
     "actions": [{"name": "post_payment", "schema": ["amount","currency","customer_id"]}],
     "request_id": "req_7a9c3f"
   }'
 ```

 sarah-support: We have Finovo and a few others reporting ordering/omission of action invocations after canary started 2026-06-12T03:20Z. Impacts payment and auth flows.

 ryan-oncall: @sarah-support paste internal request IDs and logs where action call suppressed. Is this only redwood-serval-2026?

 sarah-support: req_7a9c3f, req_7a9c4a, req_7a9c6d. All served by redwood-serval-2026 (stable+canary mix). Log excerpt:

 ```
 [2026-06-12T03:47:21Z] req_7a9c3f model=redwood-serval-2026 route=canary action_dispatch=queued
 [2026-06-12T03:47:21Z] req_7a9c3f action=post_payment args="{\"currency\":\"USD\",\"customer_id\":\"finovo-123\",\"amount\":49.99}"
 ```

 jess-eng-runtime: :eyes: Looks like args serialized by insertion order after batching/merge. We shipped batching/kernel change touching KV cache normalization and arg packing. Hypothesis: prefix batching merges arg maps across micro-batches, making field order nondeterministic. Downstream signers treat order as part of MAC. That's a bug — key order mustn't change API semantics.

 alex-product: Need impact numbers and reproducibility. If payments impacted, treat as SEV. What's canary ID? Rollback possible?

 deploy-bot: Canary rollout record: deployment=canary/v2026.2.3 started 2026-06-12T03:20Z, 25% traffic.

 jess-eng-runtime: Eng repro: shrink batching window to force micro-batches and run script; you'll see arg ordering change. Quick patch: stable serialization (sorted keys) before enqueuing to action layer. Opening PR.

 ryan-oncall: Prioritizing. Set canary.traffic=0 for v2026.2.3 and divert to v2026.2.2. Sarah, ask Finovo to share HMAC errors and retry behavior.

 sarah-support: Finovo confirmed an HMAC error and asked for rollback. Applying rollback now.

 jess-eng-runtime: PR opened: fix/stable-action-serialization. Adding integration test for stable JSON serialization and a hotfix.

 alex-product: Notify customers using webhook actions and add rollback note to incident doc. I'll join calls if needed.

 tom-customer: Thanks — please loop me when canary reverted.

 sarah-support: Canary traffic set to 0 at 2026-06-12T04:02Z. Finovo reports failures dropped to 0% within 10 minutes. Will keep monitoring and close if no further errors.

 jess-eng-runtime: Patch shipping + downstream tests. Follow-up: add stable serialization at SDK boundary to protect clients.

 sarah-support: Closing escalation pending no new reports. :thumbsup:
